database_requirements: Store original file hash/version and exact sheet/cell/range pointers.
Separate group consolidation scope and legal entity; ELS/EPS useEUR whileEswe usesSEK.
Separate actual, estimate, forecast, and scenario; annualflow,quarterflow,monthflow and balancesnapshotperiods differ.
Preserve raw numeric value, numberformat, storedunit, displayedunit and scale; units vary bysheet/column.
Keep workbook formula strings, sharedformula masters, cached value and provenance status; cached result is not independently reproduced source ledger.
Avoid automatic external-workbook execution; June P&L references a sourceworkbook not yet confirmed present.
Record nullable missing vs zero distinctly; amounts, formulas and all parameter mappings need Decimal arithmetic.
Use reported value vs recomputed value plus definitionalcomparable/incomparable/needs_review states.
privacy_scope: Only aggregatefinance values and businesssource references are sampled. HR, grants and trademark workbook contents not extracted; structural metadata only.
numeric_normalization_note: Source XLSX cached decimals include binary floating-point serialization artifacts. Comparison decimals below are quantized to currency cents (0.01 EUR) or equivalent0.00001 kEUR before comparison; raw evidence remains unchanged.
